messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — we're planning to remove the implicit /v1/models default mapping and retire the /v1/models default behavior on 2026-05-15. This will affect a lot of short snippets that rely on implicit model routing. Need docs PRs (migration guide + snippet updates) + link redirects. @olivia can you coordinate owners?

olivia: Yep, I can run coordination. Can you drop the exact list of endpoints and model mapping changes here? Also need sample apps to test. Trying to avoid a bunch of broken examples in the docs site.

rob: Summary from runtime side: previously the platform allowed requests to omit model param and routed to a default (redwood-base). For v2 behavior we want explicit model selection. Model swaps: redwood-small -> redwood-small-quant, redwood-base -> redwood-base-v2. We will provide a 30-day compat shim that logs warnings and returns X-Model:compat header. After 2026-05-15 requests without model will be rejected with 400 + migration guidance link.

rob: Example mapping (informal):
- old: (no model) -> redwood-base
- new explicit: model=redwood-base-v2
- old: redwood-small -> new: redwood-small-quant

sahil: Adding quick SDK diffs below (we should put these in the migration guide and snippets folder).

sahil: ```js
// v1-ish (implicit model)
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'Hello' });

// v2 (explicit model)
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-base-v2', prompt: 'Hello' });
```

sahil: ```py
# v1-ish
resp = client.completions.create(prompt='Hi')

# v2
resp = client.completions.create(model='redwood-base-v2', prompt='Hi')
```

maya: We also need to update any quickstarts and tutorial repos that call the old endpoints. Plus add a prominent migration callout at top of /docs/v1 pages that points to /docs/v2/migration (301s for the canonical links would be ideal). @tony can infra add redirects?

ton y: Filed INF-5473: "docs redirect: /docs/v1/* -> /docs/v2/migration/*". ETA 48h. Link: https://infra.internal/INF-5473. Assigned to netops.

olivia: PR checklist I'm going to use:
- update all inline code blocks (js/py/ts) to include explicit model param
- add a migration.md section with copy/paste diffs (short)
- add a callout about quantized model output differences and perf/cost tradeoffs
- add note about compat shim and header X-Model:compat when present
- run link-checker and remove any hardcoded /v1 URLs or add redirects
- tag eng-runtime + devex for snippet signs off

rob: Also add a small note for observability: recommend customers set model pinning in production and show how to pin in the SDK (sample snippet). I'll paste a tiny server-side snippet later.

rob: ```js
// pin model in request wrapper
function infer(prompt){
  return client.generate({ model: process.env.DEFAULT_MODEL || 'redwood-base-v2', prompt });
}
```

docs-bot: Reminder: draft deprecation notice for public docs has been generated at /drafts/deprecation-1928701234.md — please review.

olivia: I will open the migration PR today EOD and tag @rob and @sahil for technical review. If anyone else wants to own examples in the tutorials folder, reply here.

maya: I can review the examples with Rob tomorrow 10:00am PT.

rob: I'll be there. Quick ask: devex please run unit tests for snippet examples after PR.

sahil: Will add a small automated test snippet for the examples runner that asserts requests with no model throw the migration error after the freeze date.

olivia: Perfect. I'll include a checklist in the PR description: links changed, snippets updated, redirect ticket, compat note added, tests added.

maya: Thanks all :thumbsup: — goal is to have docs + redirects live 1 week before 2026-05-15 so customers get a heads-up.

olivia: Got it. Will post a follow-up thread once PR is open.
